name: Nail Holes, Gouges, and Filler in Renton Floors: What Sanding Can't Hide
title-tag: Nail Holes, Gouges and Filler: A Renton, WA Floor Guide
meta-description: Sanding removes about 1/32 inch of wood — enough for scratches, not nail holes or gouges. What filler can do, when to replace a board, and what stain reveals.
post-summary: February 24, 2027 · A full sand removes about a thirty-second of an inch of wood: enough to erase scratches and gray traffic lanes, nowhere near enough for nail holes or deep gouges. What filler honestly does, when a board should be laced in instead, and why Renton's face-nailed fir and post-carpet floors need this conversation before the estimate is signed.
